Class GuiView

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.client.view.AbstractClientView
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.client.view.gui.GuiView
All Implemented Interfaces:
ClientView
public class GuiView extends AbstractClientView
Graphical User Interface (GUI) implementation of the client view. This class handles the rendering and update of the GUI scenes based on notifications from the lobby and game models.
